amendment: docs/SPEC.md, D9(b) canonical amendment (owner, 2026-09-11) plus the fourteen Fable addenda
label: RETROSPECTIVE COMPARISON ON PREVIOUSLY EXAMINED DATES
not_a_holdout: every date below was already examined by D7 and D8. This is not a new untouched holdout and no report may call it one.

exit_policy_values.neural_or_horizon: D7/D5/D6 behaviour, the default: a decoded SELL while holding closes the position (NEURAL_SELL), and the horizon closes it otherwise (POLICY_CLOSE)
exit_policy_values.fixed_hold: this wave: a decoded SELL while holding is refused by the execution policy with RejectReason.FIXED_HOLD and closes nothing; the position closes only at the declared horizon, labelled CloseReason.POLICY_CLOSE_FIXED_HOLD

reused_artifacts_note: experiments/historical/run.py is hashed as it stood at commit edcd71d, the loop D7 ran. Commit (2) of this wave adds the exit_policy routing to it and the hash therefore moves; nothing else in the list may move, and experiments/d7/evaluate.py and withheld probe table must be byte-identical at the end of the wave.

dataset.label: HISTORICAL_MARKET
dataset.note: the same file D5/D6/D7/D8 hashed; no new download, no rolling sample, no substitution

WARMUP.note: feature initialisation only; no brain is run and no decision is written. Identical to D7.

LEARNING.note: the complete sequential decision/outcome/learning loop under the fixed-hold exit policy at H = 90

FROZEN.note: two branches, frozen_trained and frozen_reference; learning and forgetting off; end digest must equal start digest

horizon.note: amendment section 1: reuse the previously selected H. No recalibration, no new date window, no search.

anchor.rule: the exit is the open of the first available bar with bar_start >= the ENTRY FILL minute + H, in the same session
anchor.not: the decision minute + H, and not the decision minute + delay + H measured from the decision
anchor.entry: the open of the first available bar with bar_start >= decision minute + delay, same session; delay = 1, unchanged

clean_reference_checkpoint.note: amendment section 1: start from the clean reference checkpoint used for the original experiment, never from the D7 trained brain

readout.aggregation: mean of per-neuron rates over the k replicates, decoder applied once

LEARNING.one_schedule_only: one preregistered training seed schedule; no search over training seeds and no retained winner

FROZEN.why: amendment section 5: seeds must not depend on the checkpoint's weight digest, so a difference between branches is a difference in weights and not in noise

execution.cost_basis: per execution (charged on the entry and again on the exit)
execution.entry_eligibility: bar_end(t) + 1 market minute + H <= 16:00 on the same session
execution.session_close_rule: a position still open at its instrument's last available bar of the session closes at that bar's close, flagged SESSION_CLOSE_FILL and counted as an exceptional closure
execution.sequencing_guard: an entry may not fill before the previous exit filled
execution.no_invented_fills: a due fill or settlement without a valid price is a recorded Rejection, never a fabricated price and never a dropped episode
execution.reconciliation: gross_reference_pnl - fees - slippage = net_pnl, residual 0 to 1e-6
execution.unchanged: costs, sizing, delay, long-only inventory, session-boundary rules, decoder, thresholds, gain, k, MBON membership and the normalised learning rule are exactly D7's. The single permitted behavioural change in this wave is the exit policy.

closures.rule: only POLICY_CLOSE_FIXED_HOLD is an exact-H outcome. An exceptional closure keeps its own label and its own accounting, is reported separately, is never described as an exact-H outcome and is never silently discarded.

reinforcement.attributed_to: the entry decision's stored eligibility trace set (eligibility_source = replayed_from_decision)
reinforcement.not_attributed_to: any observation made while the position was open
reinforcement.rule: the existing net-outcome rule and costs, unchanged

evaluation.code: experiments/d9b/evaluate.py, importing probe_grid, labels and frozen_decisions from experiments/d7/evaluate.py without modifying it
evaluation.probe: the ordinary per-round readout, extracted from the two FROZEN event logs after both branches finished; no runtime hook and no second neural pass
evaluation.score: DECISION.valence_hz, the decoder's continuous centred V, before thresholding and before inventory constraints
evaluation.grid_rule: observation status OK and (m + 1) + delay + H <= 390, computed from the session calendar and the price file before either event log is opened
evaluation.label: G(t) = net return on notional of a hypothetical fixed-notional long entered under the existing fill convention and held H market minutes, including unchanged costs; Y(t) = 1 when G(t) > 0
evaluation.label_unavailable: UNAVAILABLE_LABEL, counted; never invented and never replaced by a loss
evaluation.primary_metric: DELTA_AUC = mean across qualifying sessions of [AUC_TRAINED - AUC_REFERENCE]
evaluation.auc: pairwise, ties at 0.5 credit; a one-class session is undefined, not 0.5
evaluation.bootstrap_seed_label: sha256('flytrade-d7-bootstrap-1')[:4] as a big-endian unsigned integer, the D7 seed, reused unchanged
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: whole qualifying sessions, both branches kept paired
evaluation.top_fraction_fixed: 0.20 is fixed and no percentile is searched over
conclusions: A: context-discrimination evidence in this experiment
B: suppression without demonstrated discrimination improvement
evaluation.positive_delta_alone_insufficient: if TRAINED remains at or below chance-level ranking

target_alignment_invariant.statement: for every completed POLICY_CLOSE_FIXED_HOLD outcome, the realised net PnL equals flytrade.horizon.Hold.net_pnl for the same decision minute, H, delay, notional and costs
target_alignment_invariant.tolerance_basis: float rounding only; the two computations use the same two reference prices and the same arithmetic, so the difference is expected to be exactly 0.0 and the tolerance is a float guard, not a modelling allowance
target_alignment_invariant.reported: per episode, with the maximum absolute difference; never assumed
target_alignment_invariant.failure_result: INVARIANT_BROKEN, reported as such, no conclusion drawn from the AUCs

expected_activity_before_the_run.chain_arithmetic: a decision at minute m fills at m+1 and closes at m+91; the next decision is at m+92, fills at m+93 and closes at m+183. D7's log shows the first usable observation of a LEARNING session at market minute 20, so the chain is 20 -> 111, 112 -> 203, 204 -> 295, 296 -> 387, and a fifth entry would need a decision at minute 388 > 298.
expected_activity_before_the_run.expected_fewer_because: an entry also needs a decoded BUY inside the open window, and vendor gaps delay fills. D7 executed 42 LEARNING entries over 3,699 rounds under an exit policy that released the inventory after 1 to 19 minutes.
expected_activity_before_the_run.correction_to_fable_addendum_5: addendum 5 states at most 3 episodes per session and at most 30 per branch. The arithmetic above gives 4 and 40. The corrected bound is recorded here, before the run, so it cannot be read as a result.

comparison_d7.note: D7's frozen branches are reported in withheld d7 frozen summary; they are not a target for this wave

inconclusive_rule_stated_before_the_run.learning: fewer than 10 completed LEARNING episodes -> INCONCLUSIVE for the learning side
inconclusive_rule_stated_before_the_run.evaluation: fewer than 5 qualifying FROZEN sessions under D7's rule (>= 10 of each label class, paired coverage >= 0.95) -> INCONCLUSIVE for the frozen comparison
inconclusive_rule_stated_before_the_run.either_fires: the wave reports INCONCLUSIVE plainly and draws no conclusion about discrimination in either direction
inconclusive_rule_stated_before_the_run.no_manufactured_activity: the dates, the decoder, the thresholds and the seeds are not changed to produce more trades

stop_conditions.eligibility_after_90_rounds: PROVEN BEFORE THE RUN. tests/d9b/test_eligibility_replay.py settles one stored k=8 trace set after 1 and after 90 full intervening k=8 decision rounds and asserts an identical LearningEvent and identical gains. Had it failed, the wave would have stopped before any run: changing decay or eligibility is a science change the owner has not authorised.
stop_conditions.invariant_broken: if any completed POLICY_CLOSE_FIXED_HOLD outcome differs from its Hold label by more than 1e-9 in net PnL, the run is reported as INVARIANT_BROKEN and no AUC conclusion is drawn
stop_conditions.digest_moved: if a FROZEN branch's end digest differs from its start digest, that branch is void
stop_conditions.artifact_moved: if any sha256 in reused_artifacts_sha256, other than the shared loop amended by commit (2), differs at the end of the wave, the run is discarded

allowed_conclusions.negative: no improvement detected under the fixed-hold policy on these periods
allowed_conclusions.positive: evidence of context discrimination in this experiment; NOT general trading ability, NOT profitability, NOT skill
allowed_conclusions.inconclusive: too few completed episodes or qualifying sessions under the rule above
forbidden: any phrasing of the form 'the fly learned'
inferring the realised reward rate from the 36.6 % LEARNING-grid positive base rate: selected entries and occupied inventory change which episodes occur
rewriting D7 conclusion B or any D8 conclusion
calling these dates a pristine or untouched holdout
reading a negative scientific result as an engineering-gate failure

runs.retry_rule: a retry after a software correction gets a new run id; the failed run's directory and its explanation are kept and reported
runs.discard_rule: a run started before the commit of this file is discarded and said to be discarded

frozen_and_not_decided_by_this_run: the encoder mapping, normalisation algorithm and bounds
the decoder formula, its sign and THETA_SD = 1.0
one normalised learning update per settled outcome
long-only inventory-aware execution, sizing, fees, modelled slippage and delay
